title: Desktop 3D printer
visual_facts: An open-frame desktop 3D printer fills the foreground.
Its frame is black with orange corner pieces and an orange control housing at the lower right.
A flat dark build plate occupies the lower center of the frame.
A print head is mounted on horizontal rails above the build plate.
A spool of light-colored filament is visible behind the frame, with a dark spool at the right edge.
A navy garment with yellow and white lettering hangs in the background.
spatial_relations: The print head is suspended above the build plate on the horizontal rails.
The control screen is attached to the printer's lower right side.
Filament spools sit behind and to the right of the printer.
uncertainties: The display's smaller text and current settings are not legible.
The image does not show a print in progress or identify the user.
